title: XAUUSD daily: 12-month return sign as regime gate + volatility sizing vs buy-and-hold
power_gate_note: Power Gate V1.4 cannot certify POWER_READY without a preregistered level calibration (NEXUS_POWER_GATE_V1). Until then every run of this hypothesis is EXPLORATORY_ONLY. Never promote to VALIDATED from this experiment alone.
data_access_statement: Written in a cloud container that has no long daily XAUUSD history for this hypothesis. No outcome, excess return or variant ranking has been computed on any real gold series before this file was committed.
question: Does any preregistered variant that gates XAUUSD daily exposure by the sign of the trailing 12-month return (with optional volatility targeting) beat a size-matched buy-and-hold after Bonferroni correction on public history before 2019, and does the frozen winner keep a positive mean excess on post-2019 confirmation windows that exclude sealed/consumed holdouts?
primary_outcome: mean_excess_log_return: arithmetic mean of (strategy_log_return - matched_bh_log_return) over evaluation days

comparator.definition: For UNIT variants: always-long weight=1. For VOL variants: always-long with the same vol-target / realized-vol rule and leverage cap. Excess = strategy daily log return minus matched BH daily log return. Falsify selection if no variant has month-block CI low > 0 after Bonferroni.

param_provenance.lookback_bars: 252 ≈ 12 trading months; Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 2012 time-series momentum formation window (a priori)
param_provenance.vol_lookback_bars: 60 trading days realized vol — common TSMOM / risk-parity choice declared a priori, not fit on gold
param_provenance.target_vol_annual: 0.10 annualized target; literature-scale vol targeting, declared a priori
param_provenance.leverage_cap: 2.0 hard cap to bound extreme inverse-vol weights
param_provenance.cost_bps_roundtrip: 1.0 bp charged on absolute weight change |w_t - w_{t-1}| — conservative daily gold friction placeholder, a priori
param_provenance.variant_ids: Exactly three variants; no additional lookbacks or thresholds in V1
param_provenance.selection_end_date: 2018-12-31 inclusive — selection only on public history before 2019 (research report #2)
param_provenance.year_concentration_max_share: 0.5 a priori: one calendar year > half of sum of positive yearly excess means → concentration falsifier

selection.access: ITERABLE — sole window for variant selection / F1; evaluation days are those with full warm-up and date < 2019-01-01
selection.note: start_utc is a lower bound; actual first evaluation day = first bar with lookback+vol warm-up available

confirmation_a.access: ITERABLE for frozen winner only; ends before consumed holdout

confirmation_b.access: ITERABLE for frozen winner only; after consumed holdout

internal_validation.access: ONE_SHOT after combined_confirmations pass with frozen params; max EXPLORATORY_PROMISING / EXPLORATORY_ONLY

excluded_phase7_sealed_holdout.access: PHYSICALLY_EXCLUDED — Phase 7 sealed holdout; runner refuses

forward_after_seal.access: NOT in V1 runner; future independence window after seal

falsification.F1_no_variant_beats_bh_after_mt: On selection, no variant has month-block bootstrap CI for mean_excess_log_return with low > 0 at Bonferroni level (1 - selection_alpha/K) → FAIL
falsification.F2_winner_ci_includes_zero_on_confirm: On combined_confirmations, month-block 95% CI for winner mean_excess_log_return includes ≤ 0 → FAIL
falsification.F3_year_concentration: Among years with n≥20 in combined confirmations, one year share of sum(max(yearly_mean_excess,0)) > year_concentration_max_share → FAIL
falsification.F4_sign_flip_across_confirmations: sign(mean_excess confirmation_a) != sign(mean_excess confirmation_b) when both n≥min_n_per_confirmation → FAIL
falsification.insufficient_n: selection n_days < min_n_selection or any confirmation n_days < min_n_per_confirmation → INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

decision_vocabulary.FAIL: F1 fires (no survivor) or F2–F4 fires on confirmation with adequate n
decision_vocabulary.EXPLORATORY_PROMISING: Survivor exists and no F2–F4 on confirmation; still EXPLORATORY_ONLY / not POWER_READY / not VALIDATED
decision_vocabulary.VALIDATED: FORBIDDEN for this hypothesis_id — requires separate promotion gate with power + true holdout + parity

exposure_statement.this_hypothesis: No real XAUUSD daily series has been read for this hypothesis.
exposure_statement.neighbouring_studies: Phase 7 / MT5 studies traversed 2022–2026 for other families. Daily trend-gate is a different estimand, but confirmation/IV calendars overlap prior research — not a virgin TRUE_HOLDOUT.
exposure_statement.consequence: Maximum after internal_validation: EXPLORATORY_PROMISING under evidence_ceiling EXPLORATORY_ONLY.
exposure_statement.rule: Parameters or variant set may change only under a new hypothesis_id. Runner refuses a run whose params hash differs from an earlier run of the same hypothesis_id.

anti_scope: No re-enable of FAILED or DEFECT_BLOCKED strategies
No MQL5 live signal wiring in V1
No variant selection on post-2018 data
known_limits: Daily mid/close CSV is not XM broker tick; costs are a 1 bp placeholder
Vol targeting and unit sizing are tested only as the three declared variants
Month-block bootstrap is descriptive, not a certified Power Gate method
Power Gate V1.4: EXPLORATORY_ONLY / NOT_ASSESSABLE until level calibration exists
Long history before ~2010 may mix spot vs futures gold depending on PC data source — document source in run meta

pc_execution.required_data: Long daily XAUUSD CSV (date, close[, open, high, low]), ideally covering ≥2005 through at least 2026-02-03 for selection+confirmations+IV
pc_execution.tester_note: MT5 Tester parity is optional later and not required to falsify V1 on daily CSV
